Atlantic Tropical Outlook

NHC issued: 200 AM EDT Fri Oct 23 2026
Subtropical Central Atlantic:
A trough of low pressure located several hundred miles east of Bermuda is producing a large area of disorganized showers and thunderstorms. Further development of this system is not expected as it moves north-northeastward into increasingly unfavorable environmental conditions during the next day or so.

E. Pacific Tropical Outlook

NHC issued: 1100 PM PDT Thu Oct 22 2026
Western Central Pacific:
An area of low pressure is forecast to form near the International Date Line, several hundred miles west of Johnston Atoll late this weekend or early next week. Environmental conditions could support some slow development thereafter while the system moves generally eastward to east-northeastward.
